comment: Editor behaviour for .tmd (Taliesin) files. Authored fresh (NOT copied from Quarto's AGPL config).

onEnterRules.comment: Continue a `:::` fenced-div block sensibly (no auto-content, just keep indentation).
Task list before the plain `-` rule below: `- [ ] x` is also a `-` item, and the first matching rule wins.
Unordered items, one rule per marker so the continuation keeps the marker the author chose (appendText takes no capture groups).

onEnterRulesComment: Every continuation rule requires the line to hold CONTENT (the trailing `\S`), which is how you LEAVE a list: Enter on an empty `- ` matches no rule and gives a plain new line. Without that the marker would repeat forever. ORDERED lists are deliberately absent: `appendText` is a literal, so onEnterRules cannot increment `1.` to `2.`, and the alternative is binding Enter itself to a command (how Markdown All in One does it), which puts the most-used key in the editor behind our own fall-through logic for the suggest widget, snippet placeholders and multi-cursor. A declarative rule that cannot fire wrongly beats an imperative one that can break Enter.
